headline: RapWire 24/7: Wiz Khalifa, Eminem, Belly Gang, Wu-Tang Clan and GTA VI
body: RapWire’s Nov. 4 evening carousel follows Wiz Khalifa’s reopened Romanian case, Eminem’s “Not Afraid” appearing in a Michigan campaign ad, Belly Gang Kushington’s album-and-tour rollout, Wu-Tang Clan’s Detroit Thanksgiving booking, and Rockstar’s GTA VI preload update. Each slide pairs current verified reporting with original late-1980s editorial-comic art, readable headline/deck layers, a visible subject, and the official transparent RapWire mark.
rendered_body_text: RapWire’s Nov. 4 evening carousel follows Wiz Khalifa’s reopened Romanian case, Eminem’s “Not Afraid” appearing in a Michigan campaign ad, Belly Gang Kushington’s album-and-tour rollout, Wu-Tang Clan’s Detroit Thanksgiving booking, and Rockstar’s GTA VI preload update. Each slide pairs current verified reporting with original late-1980s editorial-comic art, readable headline/deck layers, a visible subject, and the official transparent RapWire mark.
caption:
1) On Nov. 3, the Bucharest Court of Appeal granted Wiz Khalifa’s annulment challenge, voided the nine-month prison sentence tied to his 2024 Beach, Please! cannabis case, and canceled the execution warrant. That does not equal an acquittal: DIICOT prosecutors’ appeal is scheduled for a new hearing on Nov. 12, with video participation being arranged. @wizkhalifa’s legal status is reopened, not resolved. @Rapwire247

2) Abdul El-Sayed’s final Michigan Senate ad, released on Election Day, is soundtracked by Eminem’s 2010 hit “Not Afraid.” The track appears alongside the Democrat’s get-out-the-vote message, but a representative for Eminem said the campaign did not contact him about using it, so the clip should not be read as a confirmed endorsement. It lands weeks after Eminem appeared on Kid Rock’s “Heal My Faith.” @eminem @Rapwire247

3) Belly Gang Kushington revealed GOOD DOPE SELL ITSELF, his sophomore album, for Nov. 13 and paired it with the first WTF GOIN Tour, with Atlanta, Detroit and Houston dates from Nov. 25 through Dec. 8. The rollout follows “WTF GOIN” with 21 Savage, his first Billboard Hot 100 breakthrough and a 2026 run that also brought XXL Freshman recognition. The album is the next test of whether that breakout can travel beyond one hit. @bellygangkushington @Rapwire247

4) Wu-Tang Clan will headline the Detroit Lions’ Thanksgiving Day halftime show on Nov. 26 when Detroit hosts the Chicago Bears at Ford Field. The game is set for national CBS coverage, and Eminem plus Paul Rosenberg are returning as executive producers who select the talent. The booking comes as Wu-Tang closes its farewell tour and heads into its Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. @wutangclan @Rapwire247

5) Rockstar says digital pre-load for GTA VI begins Nov. 10, while the console install needs about 212 GB ahead of the Nov. 19 launch. That gives players a concrete final countdown and a serious storage check before Jason and Lucia’s Vice City-era world opens on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. @rockstargames @Rapwire247

slide_editorial_copy.headline: WIZ KHALIFA'S SENTENCE RESET
slide_editorial_copy.deck: A Bucharest appellate court voided the rapper's nine-month Romanian prison judgment and warrant on Nov. 3, but prosecutors' appeal returns Nov. 12; the case is reopened, not over.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: EMINEM'S TRACK HITS THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Abdul El-Sayed's Michigan Senate ad uses 'Not Afraid'; an Eminem representative said the campaign never reached out, so the song's appearance is not a public endorsement.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: BELLY GANG LOCKS IN THE NEXT MOVE
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Belly Gang Kushington set GOOD DOPE SELL ITSELF for Nov. 13 and announced his first multi-city WTF GOIN Tour, turning a 2026 breakout into a bigger test.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: WU-TANG TAKES THANKSGIVING
slide_editorial_copy.deck: The New York collective will headline the Detroit Lions' Nov. 26 Thanksgiving halftime show on CBS, with Eminem and Paul Rosenberg producing the national broadcast.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: GTA VI PRELOADS AHEAD OF LAUNCH
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Rockstar says digital pre-load begins Nov. 10 and the console install needs about 212 GB, giving players a final countdown before the Nov. 19 release.
